newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokai Aluminum shares up on security tag reports.
newsitem.headline: Tokai Aluminum shares up on security tag reports.

text.p: Shares in Tokai Aluminum Foil Co Ltd rose in the over-the-counter market on Thursday morning, inspired by recent media reports that its unit was boosting production of security tags for protection against shoplifting, brokers said.
As of 0111 GMT, the shares stood at 445 yen, up from 420 yen on Wednesday when they added 20 yen.

Tokai Electronics Co Ltd, a unit of Tokai Aluminum Foil Co Ltd, said on Thursday that it plans to increase its output of shop-lifting prevention tags to 150 million from the current 50 million per month.
